product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix provides enterprises with cloud networking and zero-trust security software to connect and protect their cloud networks and workloads.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists for Aviatrix Clearance.

employee_band.notes: Company-reported LinkedIn size band, not an exact headcount.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include Chief Scientist Susan Hinrichs on policy compilation and distributed enforcement, and Technical Marketing Engineer Tim McConnaughy on data-plane architecture, IPsec and encryption.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes getting-started guides, platform architecture and API reference material.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The published job board lists openings, but none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The Workload Attack Path Assessment terms say Aviatrix uses OpenRouter to access various AI models; they do not identify the underlying model providers.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly listed compliance claims; GDPR is not a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 8, 2021; the funding-history profile identifies this as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly recorded round is September 2021, outside the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Strategic Account Executive — United States is listed as open.

launched_6mo.notes: Harvest and Decrypt Protection launched on September 22, 2026, adding quantum-safe key exchange.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The nine-person leadership roster and available appointment histories were reviewed. Identified joins predate the window, and no qualifying departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The inside-sales posting names Salesforce and Outreach.io and/or Salesloft; this does not establish that both engagement platforms are deployed.
